title: Kusanagi Nene — Sharp-Tongued And Unsociable〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Finally, it's lunch break... Now I can continue the video.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Professional troupe members can sing and dance so well...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The way they say their lines makes them so easy to catch... I'm still a long way off...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Maybe I should do more vocal training after our practice sessions on the stage...hm?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I feel like someone's staring at me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh gosh... I didn't notice him in front at all...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(H-He talked!
Even though I've never really seen him talk much to anyone before...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(So much pressure...
I can't concentrate on the video like this...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you want me to recycle this? Oh, there's a note inside.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I get distracted when there's someone's around.
Search for it and watch it yourself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya! You not gonna go buy lunch?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No problem, but...did that girl just throw a piece of paper trash at you just now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, you've got it wrong. She was just...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That should have gotten rid of the nuisance...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe I'll just watch it quietly with earphones...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sigh. I should have done that right from the start...
